text.en: Pet owners consistently commend groomer Janice for her passionate work ethic, attentive customer service, and flexible scheduling on Kingsway. Clients appreciate her gentle nature and willingness to take time with every appointment. Reviewers note that her welcoming and calm approach builds strong trust with pet parents and animals alike.

Reviewers highlight how well the groomer manages nervous puppies and shy rescue animals. Pet parents share that kittens and anxious cats return home relaxed, cheerful, and playful after their sessions. Clients value the calm energy of the private studio, noting that pets who normally fear strangers feel secure throughout the entire grooming process.

Clients express high satisfaction with the grooming results, specifically praising precision lion cuts on long-haired cats and thorough tidy-ups for young puppies. Reviewers note that pets leave the studio looking neat, handsome, and impeccably styled. Pet owners emphasize the dedicated effort invested in delivering positive grooming outcomes.

q.en: Does PawMazing Studio provide grooming for cats?

a.en: Yes, the studio grooms cats, including lion cuts and gentle brush-outs for long-haired felines.

q.en: How does the studio handle first-time puppies and kittens?

a.en: Reviewers emphasize that the calm environment and gentle handling ensure a positive introductory experience for young pets.
Yes, clients can schedule grooming sessions online via the Vagaro booking platform.

q.en: Where is PawMazing Studio located in Vancouver?

a.en: The studio is located at 3266 Kingsway in East Vancouver.
